hypotheses.C1_native_channel_decomposition_is_exact: All native product channels reconstruct every Layer-3 MLP write delta within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.C2_top64_is_locally_sufficient: Top-64 channels reach at least 0.50 median local write fidelity on both semantic corpora.
hypotheses.C3_top256_is_near_locally_sufficient: Top-256 channels reach at least 0.80 median local write fidelity on both semantic corpora.
hypotheses.C4_top256_is_downstream_sufficient_for_m: Top-256 patches reach at least 0.50 median Fisher fidelity to the full MLP3-only downstream effect on both corpora.
hypotheses.C5_native_channels_recur_by_lexical_pair: Top-64 same-pair Jaccard against disjoint FineWeb references is at least 0.10 for both FineWeb and TinyStories queries.
hypotheses.C6_native_channels_recur_by_semantic_fam: Excluding identical pairs, same-family top-64 Jaccard exceeds different-family Jaccard by at least 0.02 on both query corpora.
hypotheses.C7_semantic_edits_are_more_channel_conce: Semantic top-64 local fidelity exceeds the cross-family target null by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.C8_semantic_and_null_channel_sets_differ: Median same-context top-64 Jaccard between semantic and cross-family-null edits is at most 0.25 on both corpora.
